disposition_reason: The original conference paper supplies ordered macro-F1 targets for the full nine-panel Bugeon scope, and pinned author code defines the readout and split regimes. Exact paper-era artifact equivalence, native reference execution, meaningful-effect/uncertainty policy and concrete budgets remain unresolved, so this is a source-grounded design rather than an admitted task.

source_paper.title: Know Thyself by Knowing Others: Learning Neuron Identity from Population Context

evidence.supports: Nine Bugeon macro-F1 panel results, reported as five-training-seed means and standard deviations; EI inductive LOLCAT exceeds NuCLR.

evidence.locator: Appendix B.3 and D.4, pages 19 and 22
evidence.supports: Calcium population input and the three Bugeon exposure/split regimes; four development sessions excluded from final test.
Nine named split files and resampling readout route; downloadable split bytes are not immutable or verified here.

evidence.locator: balanced_resampling; logreg_scores; checkpoint selection and final prediction concatenation
evidence.supports: Train-only standardization, logistic regression, CV macro-F1 selection and pooled final macro-F1 aggregation.
Five SB028 sessions excluded from representation training; one is development-only.
Session-local neuron IDs, transcriptomic label derivation, fluorescence normalization, and omitted UniqueID ingestion.
Embedding float32 conversion, increasing-epoch ordering and matching neuron IDs across checkpoints.

target.description: Predict Bugeon neuron E/I, five-subclass and eleven-class identity from population-context representations, retaining transductive, transductive-zero-shot and inductive-zero-shot panels.

dataset.description: Bugeon transcriptomic calcium data, represented as bugeon_transcriptomic_2022 in the pinned preparation code; exact source archive, metadata and paper-era split byte identities still require acquisition validation.

cohort.description: Seventeen sessions across four mice; preserve all source-eligible neurons and stimulus-specific subrecordings. Repeated-cell linkage and label-map joins remain execution holds.

split.description: Source protocol: neuron-wise transductive split; four-subject leave-one-out transductive zero-shot; SB028 held out for inductive zero-shot, with three-subject CV. Four development sessions never enter final tests. Exact distributed split equivalence to conference results is not verified.

inputs.description: Calcium population activity supplies representations; transcriptomic labels train the downstream readout only within source folds. Transductive representation training sees test-population activity; inductive representation training excludes all SB028 sessions.

preprocessing.description: Pinned preparation concatenates stimulus experiments with one-hour offsets, retains session-local neuron indices and forms fluorescence normalized by its flattened 99th percentile. Readout casts/standardizes embeddings using training data and uses author class resampling, without substituting class weighting.

metric.description: Macro F1: average of per-class 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN) for the author evaluator label set; source sklearn macro-F1 behavior must be retained. Accuracy and balanced accuracy are diagnostics, not interchangeable victory metrics.

aggregation.description: Within each panel, concatenate selected outer-test predictions before macro-F1; choose each checkpoint by pooled CV macro-F1. Conference scores then average five training seeds. Do not average subjects or all nine panels into an invented source score.

comparison.primary_metric: Panel-specific macro-F1 across all nine registered Bugeon tasks; five-subclass inductive-zero-shot value is the scalar provenance anchor, not a suite aggregate

published_baseline.description: Anchor: NuCLR five-subclass inductive 0.3938 ± 0.0556. Remaining NuCLR means (transductive/transductive-zero-shot/inductive): EI 0.8110/0.6826/0.6738; five-subclass 0.6101/0.4014/0.3938; eleven-class 0.4056/0.2333/0.1990. For EI inductive, the paper also reports stronger LOLCAT 0.7463 ± 0.0095; beating 0.6738 alone does not surpass that source-paper result.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned author preprocessing, training and readout provide a recovery route, but no authentic reference run on verified conference-equivalent splits has been established.

minimum_effect.rationale: Predeclare panel-specific practically meaningful macro-F1 gains after validating source label prevalence and reference repeatability. Published seed standard deviations are not effect thresholds; no common made-up delta is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired method comparisons across training seeds and the original subject structure, with multiplicity across the nine panels; quantify conditional-on-cohort and population-generalization uncertainty separately.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological generalization; independently trained seed for optimization variability. Repeated neuron observations and CV folds are not independent mice.
uncertainty.rationale: The inductive panel has one test mouse (SB028), so a mouse-population confidence claim cannot be created by treating its neurons or seeds as independent animals. Repeated-cell identities require reconciliation.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact conference-equivalent data, eligible neurons, split files, source readout and all nine panel conditions; any changed split is a separately labeled extension.
Compare each retained panel to its matching published source result and independently rerun author method; preserve stronger source comparators, including EI inductive LOLCAT 0.7463.

Freeze the primary panel decision, protected remaining panels, meaningful effects and joint uncertainty rule before candidate selection; no selecting a favorable label level or exposure regime after results.
Report the complete nine-panel result vector. The scalar baseline field cannot authorize a narrowed one-panel or smaller-cohort paper win.
Complete native reference qualification, final-evaluation protection and concrete common access/compute budgets before admitting an improvement episode.

current_sota.description: The paper tables establish source-era comparators only. No present-day SOTA survey or claim was performed.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate on representations using only the exact source training/development information and author CV feedback, preserving all nine exposure/label panels. Hold source test labels owner-side.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method/code, inputs, context policy, hyperparameters, allowed checkpoint-selection rule, seeds, split/label digests and panel-wise success rule before final test scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Run the frozen candidate and qualified source methods on the unchanged paper tests; publish complete panel results and predeclared uncertainty. A new subject split can be an extension but never substitutes for the source task.
episode.baseline_policy: Published table values, authentic rerun values and current SOTA remain separate. A supplied-embedding local readout or context-ablation improvement alone cannot be a paper win.

blocking_issues: Paper-era split bytes and exact source archive/metadata identity are not validated; the current split download cannot silently substitute for them.
Session-local neuron IDs do not establish repeated-cell linkage; label-map and fluorescence-column joins require audit.
No authentic NuCLR or stronger EI-inductive source-comparator rerun is established.
The one-mouse inductive test cannot support a general population uncertainty claim by neuron-level resampling.
Primary-versus-protected panel decision, meaningful effects, multiple-panel inference, protected scorer and concrete episode budgets are not fixed.

legacy.notes: The existing supplied-embedding evaluator checks identities, readout behavior and context-ablation diagnostics. Its generated controls and reproduction outputs are calibration only; original graders and historical task materials remain preserved.
